purpose: K15: compare specialized NEXO semantic discovery with a competent ordinary tool-using agent on the identical information-gap family, not a different preloaded-demand scenario.
reference: B9 uses the same configured real model and research tools on received raw source batches, without NEXO's separate semantic perception stage. It may investigate, confirm and prepare actions; every owner still reviews. Both arms retain free structured ingestion, common finite physical resources, current permissions and the shared deterministic response compiler.
reuse: A completed B6 result from the corrected original primary can be reused only with identical seed, corpus, config, current candidate/evaluator/engine hashes, model settings and a passed run integrity gate. Its paid usage is counted once. Otherwise run the pair together and preserve both.
endpoints: Sufficient physical aid with censoring at the same 3h horizon and first useful aid
Native deficits, coverage, excessive deliveries, duplicate execution and ledger invariants
Confirmation requests, provider calls, failures, known and conservatively charged costs
Received sources, exposed sources, interpreted/investigated sources and unresolved queue
limits: One seed is a scoped mechanism contrast, not a stable general-agent superiority estimate; every outcome, including B9 outperforming NEXO, is retained.
This reference is one declared implementation of a general agent, not a claim that no other agent architecture can match the result.
No observer truth, hidden evaluator labels, future messages, unrestricted owner powers, free provider time or weaker physical world for either arm.
If budget or validation prevents completion, retain it as incomplete; no imputation and no replacement by a favorable run.
